*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Camera-guided controller and action record for the OpenSingleDoor episode.
+
+Usage: python /app/output/gen.py observe [tag]
+       python /app/output/gen.py move TAG N DX DY DZ [GRIP]
+       python /app/output/gen.py raw TAG N "12 comma-separated channels"
+
+Actions are held for N native control steps and saved alongside the resulting
+camera views, depth, proprioception, and request parameters in /app/runs.
+"""
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+ROOT = Path("/app/runs")
+CAMERAS = ["robot0_agentview_center", "robot0_agentview_left", "robot0_agentview_right", "robot0_eye_in_hand"]
+
+
+def main():
+    r = Robot()
+    op = sys.argv[1]
+    tag = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "current"
+    out = ROOT / tag
+    if op == "observe":
+        result = r.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video="none")
+    elif op in ("move", "raw"):
+        n = int(sys.argv[3])
+        if op == "move":
+            a = np.zeros(12)
+            a[:3] = list(map(float, sys.argv[4:7]))
+            a[6] = float(sys.argv[7]) if len(sys.argv) > 7 else -1.0
+            a[11] = -1.0
+        else:
+            a = np.fromstring(sys.argv[4], sep=",")
+            if a.shape != (12,):
+                raise ValueError("expected twelve channels")
+        out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        (out / "action.json").write_text(json.dumps({"n": n, "action": a.tolist()}, indent=2))
+        result = r.submit("ee_delta", np.tile(a, (n, 1)), cameras=CAMERAS,
+                          include_depth=True, video="none", interpolate="hold", note=tag)
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(op)
+    result.save(str(out))
+    p = dict(zip(result.meta["proprio"]["layout"], result.meta["proprio"]["now"]))
+    print(json.dumps({"tag": tag, "time_left_s": result.meta["time_left_s"],
+                      "control_steps": result.meta["control_steps"],
+                      "eef": [p[k] for k in ("eef_right_x", "eef_right_y", "eef_right_z")],

+                      "done": result.done, "reason": result.meta.get("reason")}))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
